summary: Chrome Extension v6.1.0 Testing Complete - All backend APIs working correctly. Extension download endpoint returns valid zip with v6.1.0 manifest. Frontend loads and displays projects correctly. FF&E spreadsheet functional with 113 items.
passed_tests: Chrome extension download endpoint returns 200 OK
Download returns valid zip file with correct content-type
Zip contains manifest.json
Manifest version is 6.1.0 (verified)
Zip contains popup.js with Four Hands scraper logic
Download filename header is design-ready-scraper-v6.1.0.zip
GET /api/projects returns 200 with list of projects
Projects have required fields (id, name) for extension dropdown
POST /api/extension-scrape accepts scraped data
GET /api/extension-scrape-cache returns cached data
GET /api/extension-scrape-cache with URL parameter works
GET /api/extension-scrape-latest returns most recent scrape
POST /api/ai-scrape endpoint exists and accepts requests
AI scrape with Four Hands format works
popup.js has Four Hands SKU extraction logic (text-neutral-50 selector, /product/ URL pattern)
popup.js has Four Hands dimensions logic (w x d x h format)
popup.js has Four Hands swatch extraction logic (label[title] elements)
Frontend homepage loads correctly
Projects list displays with 3 projects
Project detail page loads with all tabs
FF&E tab loads with Kitchen room and 113 items
FF&E spreadsheet displays items with all columns (VENDOR/SKU, QTY, SIZE, FINISH/COLOR, COST/PRICE, IMAGE, STOCK STATUS, RESTOCK/LEAD TIME, ORDER DATE)
critical_code_review_comments: Chrome Extension v6.1.0 correctly implements Four Hands vendor-specific logic for SKU extraction (from subtitle or URL), dimensions (w x d x h format), and swatch images (label elements with title attributes)
Extension properly handles project selection dropdown with persistence via chrome.storage.local
Backend extension-scrape endpoints correctly cache and retrieve scraped data
seed_data_creation: 3 test projects auto-created on startup (Modern Kitchen Design, Luxury Master Suite, Designer Living Room) with 360 total items
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chrome Extension v6.1.0 testing complete. All backend APIs for extension functionality working. The extension itself is a client-side Chrome extension that cannot be directly tested in this environment - user must install and test in their browser. Key endpoints tested: /api/download/chrome-extension (returns v6.1.0 zip), /api/projects (for extension dropdown), /api/extension-scrape (for caching scraped data), /api/ai-scrape (for AI-powered extraction). Frontend FF&E spreadsheet working with full item tracking columns.

four_hands_features.dimensions: w x d x h format (e.g., 21.50"w x 23.00"d x 38.50"h)
four_hands_features.swatch_images: From label[title] elements containing img tags

chrome_extension_testing_notes.user_testing_required: Extension must be installed in Chrome browser and tested on actual vendor websites (Uttermost, Four Hands) to verify scraping functionality
